events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Power
angles.copy: From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', Chrissie Hynde has given us some incredible tracks. What's your all-time favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Rock and roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It!
angles.copy: Love him or... well, you probably just love him. Liam Gallagher is 54 today. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Licence to Thrill
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Which actor played the best Bond, and what's your favourite 007 movie?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine His Impact
angles.copy: A true visionary and musical genius. On what would have been John Lennon's 86th birthday, we celebrate his incredible legacy. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Funny Man
angles.copy: From Fawlty Towers to Monty Python, John Cleese has brought us so much laughter. What's your favourite John Cleese moment or character?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On the anniversary of his passing, we pay tribute to the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: His voice, his stage presence, his legend. Remembering Freddie Mercury on this day. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their evolution.

angles.name: Revolver's Predecessor
angles.copy: An album that changed everything. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' is 61 today. What's your favourite track from this classic?
